title: Chapter 662
text:
Han Xiao felt his body become sluggish and heavy. In the blink of an eye, he was stacked with a bunch of negative buffs.

"She really hasn't changed." Han Xiao's mouth twitched. He was not surprised at all.

He had cleared Stephanie's dungeon hundreds of times and had long memorized her moves. Even though the Stephanie in the dungeon had been weakened, her abilities had not changed. Han Xiao knew her battle style like the back of his hand. Stacking buffs on the enemy at the start was exactly the same.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao used Void Travel to increase the distance between them. Stephanie was better at close combat, and she dealt extra damage to metal. He did not want his mechanical suit to be destroyed early.

"Luckily, I killed that Psychic called Zeglin first. Otherwise, it would be even more troublesome."

Han Xiao did not stop moving. He controlled the Mech Legion to use the entanglement tactic in Philip's data to delay Stephanie and the others from charging toward him. He himself used the Mountain Ape mechanical suit and used the army as a barrier to move around. From time to time, he would approach the Mage and the two Mechanic enemies, attempting to engage in close combat.

With nine senior Calamity Grades, the Mech Legion was under immense pressure. Very soon, they fell into a tough battle. Broken machines fell to the ground one after another, and Han Xiao used (Waste Modification) to pick them up and return to the battlefield.

In his sight was a chaotic battlefield. The built-in tactical screen displayed all kinds of parameters. Han Xiao calmly analyzed the situation.

Stephanie used her ability to interfere with the electromagnetic waves in a large area around her. Han Xiao could not communicate with Wilton and the others. The Philip sub-program that he had left for Wilton out of caution immediately came into effect. Although he could not receive the location of the reinforcements, he could confirm that they were on their way. His mission now was not to fight head-on but to stall for time and wait for the reinforcements to arrive.

…

Rumble!

The battle between the ten Calamity Grade Supers shook the mountains and the earth. The mountain range had long been flattened, and the ice plains cracked. Many rifts that stretched for hundreds of miles extended out, like the opening of the earth.

The wind and clouds also changed color. The originally clear sky was filled with white clouds, but now, lightning flashed and thunder rumbled, and dark clouds pressed down.

Han Xiao kept shifting the battlefield away from the populated areas of the Northern Continent. He kept running towards the uninhabited glaciers. Wherever they passed, the frozen earth that had been frozen for thousands of years cracked, mountains shook, avalanches rolled, and the earth was in a mess.

The aftermath of the battle between the Calamity Grade Supers was causing natural disasters on this planet. With the battlefield as the center, seismic waves spread throughout the entire Northern Continent. In the coastal areas far away from the battlefield, the sky had already darkened, and the sea was turbulent. Tsunamis and hurricanes hit the coastal cities.

"A tsunami is coming! Run!"

"What, what is going on?!"

The commoners in the coastal cities in the North Continent were shocked by the sudden natural disaster, and their expressions changed as they fled.

…

Han Xiao naturally could not see the reactions of these people, but he did not need to think to know that the aftermath of the battle between these Calamity Grades had already caused a disaster in Blue Star.

"You purposely chose this place as the battlefield for this purpose, didn't you?" Han Xiao's expression was unfriendly. He dodged another invisible tornado-like shockwave from Stephanie, and the mechanical soldiers behind him were scattered.

The two sides had already shifted the battlefield several times, and the battle had already reached its climax. Mushrooms had already been planted several times.

The blue starlight in the sky burned again. It was another round of Psionic Sky Cannon attacks controlled by Philip!

Rumble!!

The Mech Legion quickly avoided the bombardment area, and so did Stephanie and the others. Only the enemy Mechanic's battle fortress moved slowly and did not escape the attack range. Its shield shattered, and the battered fortress exploded into pieces.

This was already the second battle fortress of the enemy that had been destroyed.

Making use of this opportunity, Han Xiao retreated with the Mech Legion. They were already at the border of the Northern Continent, and he started to move toward the sea.

"Troublesome Sky Cannon." Stephanie frowned. She looked up and pointed at a Pugilist. "You, go and destroy Black Star's Sky Cannon."

This Pugilist nodded. Flames spurted out from his feet, and he shot into the sky like a rocket. In the blink of an eye, he turned into a star in the sky and headed toward outer space.

"Don't waste time. Black Star is good at prolonged battles. Hurry up and subdue him."

Stephanie's tone was impatient, and she chased after him with the other members.

She knew that Black Star was very difficult to kill, and the purpose of this trip was not to kill Han Xiao but to capture him. However, Han Xiao was too slippery, running even faster than a war reporter. She had not been able to get close to Han Xiao. Only in close combat could the power of her Esper Ability be maximized.

After chasing for a while, the two sides clashed again in the sky above the sea. The aftermath created huge waves, and waves of energy blasted into the sea, forming huge whirlpools on the surface of the sea.

The sky darkened!

As the casualties of the Mech Legion continued to rise, Han Xiao started to show signs of weakness and revealed an opening. Stephanie's eyes sparkled. She grabbed the opportunity and turned into a black shadow. She suddenly appeared behind Han Xiao and pressed her palm toward Han Xiao's back.

This was the first time she had used this ability since the start of the battle. She was prepared to catch Black Star off guard. As long as she hit him, Black Star's strength would be temporarily weakened by at least ten percent!

However, the next moment, there was nothing under her palm. Han Xiao seemed to have expected this. He dodged her palm with a strange posture, flicked out a cluster of psionic energy from his hands, and slapped her chest with a backhand.

Bang!

The light blue Psionic Impact Ring exploded, and Stephanie flew thousands of meters away. She rubbed her aching chest and frowned. She was secretly surprised by Han Xiao's reaction speed.

One had to know that this ambush came without any warning, leaving Black Star with only microseconds to react.

On the other side, Han Xiao secretly sighed in relief. Stephanie was also a boss-level character. Just like him, she had many skills other than her Esper Abilities. If he did not know, he would be easily tricked. However, he knew Stephanie's abilities too well. There was no way he would be tricked. He had not done hundreds of dungeons for nothing.

"She's stronger than the rumors say." Stephanie narrowed her eyes. Just as she was about to attack again, she suddenly noticed a few high-energy individuals rapidly approaching. Her expression changed, and she stopped where she was, not acting rashly.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He immediately looked up and saw six meteors falling from the sky, hovering above them.

The flames dimmed, revealing Wilton and the others. Looking at the shocked gazes of Stephanie and the others, Wilton snorted coldly and raised his hand. Only then did everyone realize that he was holding someone in his hand.

Stephanie took a closer look, and her expression changed drastically.

The person in Wilton's hand was the Pugilist she had ordered to destroy the Sky Cannons. At this time, there was no sign of life. He had clearly been beaten to death.

These six are enemies … Stephanie and the remaining seven Calamity Grade Supers all had terrible expressions.

Wilton let go, and the corpse fell into the sea. It was swept away by the whirlpool and disappeared without a trace.

"Black Star, we're late." Wilton nodded.

Han Xiao's lips curled up.

Reinforcements are here!

He looked at Stephanie, shrugged, and chuckled.

"Are you surprised? Are you surprised?"

Seeing that Black Star had expected this, Stephanie could not remain calm. Deep shock flashed through her eyes.

He found reinforcements long ago?

Six Calamity Grade Supers?

Why would he call so many strong people to deal with the internal conflict of a surface civilization?

Unless …

Stephanie's heart skipped a beat.

Black Star knew that we were ambushing him?
